issues.description: ValueError for unsupported delimiter is undocumented and conflates programmer error with client-input error channel.
issues.detail: The new precondition raises bare ValueError, but the Raises clause only documents HTTPBadRequest, and the surrounding method already treats ValueError from transforms as client-input failure. Either document the ValueError explicitly as a programmer error distinct from HTTPBadRequest, or use TypeError/assertion to separate the two failure modes cleanly.

issues.description: Delimiter silently no-ops when value is already a list from multiple param instances, weakening the postcondition.
issues.detail: When the same param appears multiple times, items is already a list and delimiter is ignored. The Note documents this but the contract is conditional on runtime type. Either re-split list elements with the delimiter, explicitly reject the combination, or state the postcondition as a firm contract. Also verify transform still applies post-split.

issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates OpenAPI symbolic style names with literal delimiter characters in one namespace.
issues.detail: Mixing 'pipeDelimited' aliases with literal ',', '|', ' ' as keys in one dict muddies the contract and produces redundant identity entries. A typed Literal/enum plus a small alias map, or two frozensets, would make the precondition expressible in one line and avoid future key collisions.

issues.description: Tests omit boundary cases: blank tokens, default/missing param with delimiter, and transform+delimiter combination.
issues.detail: Current tests cover happy paths and the unsupported-delimiter rejection, but do not pin behavior for 'a,,b' style empty tokens, delimiter set with a missing param returning default, keep_blank_qs_values interaction, trailing delimiters, or delimiter combined with transform. Add small tests so the contract is locked rather than demonstrated.

issues.description: Missing regression test pinning the default delimiter=None path preserves prior behavior.
issues.detail: The change is opt-in, but no explicit test asserts that calling get_param_as_list without delimiter on a comma-containing value (with auto_parse_qs_csv False) returns a single-element list. One cheap regression test would guard the unchanged default path.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small, well-scoped patch that lands close to ready. The main shared concerns are at the specification layer: ValueError for a bad delimiter is undocumented and shares a channel with client-input errors, and the delimiter silently no-ops when the value is already a list, weakening the postcondition. The _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS table mixes symbolic OpenAPI style names with literal characters in one namespace, which all three reviewers flagged as taste/clarity debt. Tests cover happy paths but miss boundary cases (blank tokens, missing-param-with-delimiter, transform+delimiter, default-path regression). Verdict: land with the documented cleanups.
